html:
Bay Mau Coconut Forest, a green gem nestled in the heart of Hoi An, is a must-visit destination renowned for its unspoiled natural beauty and unique river-based cultural experiences. This article provides detailed and up-to-date information on basket boat ticket prices for 2026, highlights exciting activities, and shares essential travel tips to help you enjoy a truly memorable visit.

Bay Mau Coconut Forest is a lush green oasis hidden within the tranquil countryside of Hoi An. With endless rows of water coconut palms stretching along winding waterways, this destination offers visitors a peaceful escape and an authentic glimpse into traditional rural life in Central Vietnam. Drifting gently along narrow canals in a traditional basket boat while immersing yourself in the cool, green surroundings is an experience not to be missed. So, how much does a basket boat ride cost in 2026, and what should you know to make the most of your trip? Let us explore Bay Mau Coconut Forest in detail.

Where Is Bay Mau Coconut Forest And How To Get There?

Bay Mau Coconut Forest is located in Cam Thanh Commune, Hoi An City, Quang Nam Province, approximately 3–5 kilometers southeast of Hoi An Ancient Town. Its convenient location makes it easy to combine a visit to the historic town with an eco-cultural experience in nature.

The name “Bay Mau,” meaning “Seven Acres,” originates from the forest’s original size of around 70,000 square meters. Over time, thanks to alluvial deposits, the forest has expanded significantly and is now one of the largest and most beautiful water coconut forests in Central Vietnam.

Popular Transportation Options

Visitors can reach Bay Mau Coconut Forest from Hoi An by several means, each offering a different experience:

  • Motorbike: A popular and budget-friendly option, especially among younger travelers. The journey takes about 10–15 minutes and passes scenic rice fields and peaceful villages.

  • Bicycle: Ideal for those who enjoy slow travel and fresh air. The flat and safe route allows you to fully appreciate the rural landscape.

  • Taxi or Grab: Convenient and comfortable for families or groups, with fares ranging from approximately 70,000 to 100,000 VND depending on distance.

  • Tour Bus or Package Tour: Many travel agencies offer half-day or full-day tours that include transportation, entrance fees, and guided activities, allowing for a stress-free experience.

No matter which option you choose, the journey itself is part of the charm, offering a peaceful introduction to the countryside of Hoi An.

Updated Entrance Fees And Basket Boat Ticket Prices 2026

Understanding ticket prices in advance helps you plan your budget more effectively. Below is the latest information on entrance fees and basket boat rental prices for 2026:

Entrance Fee

  • 30,000 VND per person

  • This fee covers entry to the tourist area only and does not include basket boat rides or additional activities.

Basket Boat Ride Price

  • 150,000 VND per basket boat

  • Each basket boat typically accommodates up to two adults

  • The price includes a local boat operator and life jackets

  • Ride duration is approximately 45–60 minutes

Additional Services And Tour Packages

  • Group tours often include entrance tickets, basket boat rides, local meals, and cultural activities at a more competitive price.

  • Larger basket boats for groups of four are available for around 300,000 VND per boat.

  • Prices may vary slightly during peak seasons, holidays, or depending on service providers. Always confirm prices before using services.

Unmissable Experiences At Bay Mau Coconut Forest

Bay Mau Coconut Forest offers much more than scenic views. It is a place where visitors can actively engage in local culture and river-based traditions.

1. Basket Boat Ride Through The Coconut Forest

Glide through winding canals beneath dense coconut palm canopies while local boatmen skillfully navigate the waterways. The cool air, gentle water sounds, and vibrant greenery create a relaxing and immersive experience. You may also spot fish, crabs, and other aquatic life beneath the palms.

2. Watch Traditional Basket Boat Spinning Performances

One of the most exciting highlights is the basket boat spinning show. Local performers demonstrate impressive techniques, spinning and balancing the boats with remarkable skill, creating splashes and cheers from the crowd.

3. Learn Traditional Fishing Techniques

Visitors can try casting fishing nets or catching crabs by hand under the guidance of experienced fishermen. These hands-on activities offer insight into the daily livelihoods of the local community.

4. Make Handicrafts From Coconut Leaves

Participate in a creative workshop where you can learn to make souvenirs such as rings, hats, toys, or small animals from fresh coconut leaves a meaningful keepsake from your visit.

5. Enjoy Local Cuisine

After exploring, enjoy regional specialties such as grilled seafood, banh xeo (Vietnamese savory pancakes), nem lui (lemongrass skewers), and fresh coconut-based desserts at riverside restaurants.

6. Capture Stunning Photos

With its emerald-green scenery, colorful basket boats, and golden sunlight, Bay Mau Coconut Forest is a paradise for photography lovers. Early morning and late afternoon offer the best lighting.

Best Time To Visit Bay Mau Coconut Forest

  • Dry Season (February to August): Ideal weather with minimal rain and clear skies. March to May offers particularly pleasant temperatures.

  • Flood Season (September to November): The forest becomes lush and vibrant, and higher water levels allow deeper exploration, though weather conditions should be monitored.

  • Best Time Of Day: Early morning or late afternoon to avoid strong sunlight and enjoy cooler temperatures.

What To Prepare Before Visiting

  • Sunscreen, hat, sunglasses

  • Light, breathable clothing

  • Comfortable footwear or sandals

  • Camera or smartphone (waterproof bag recommended)

  • Cash for small expenses

  • Personal medications if needed

  • Drinking water and light snacks

Cultural And Historical Significance

Beyond its natural beauty, Bay Mau Coconut Forest holds deep historical value. During the Vietnam War, it served as an important revolutionary base thanks to its dense vegetation and complex waterways. Today, it stands as a symbol of resilience and harmony between people and nature.

Friendly local boat operators are often happy to share stories about the forest’s history and traditions, enriching your visit with meaningful cultural insights.

Important Notes For Visitors

  • Protect the environment and avoid littering

  • Always wear a life jacket during boat rides

  • Politely negotiate prices when traveling independently

  • Respect local customs and traditions

  • Book services in advance during peak seasons

  • Use waterproof bags to protect valuables

Conclusion

Bay Mau Coconut Forest is more than just a tourist attraction it is a unique eco-cultural experience where visitors can reconnect with nature and discover the charm of river life in Central Vietnam. With updated information on basket boat ticket prices for 2026 and practical travel tips, we hope this guide helps you plan a smooth and unforgettable journey to this remarkable destination.
